correctness.rationale: Brevig-Søvik 2026, Corollary 3, reduces every H^(1/2) coefficient extremal to P^4 with a degree-three outer polynomial. Parseval converts its norm exactly to squared coefficient l2 energy. Global nonnegative quartic optimization: all maxima are interior; four Euler-Lagrange equations reduce to a unique admissible root of F(t)=5t^3+22t^2-27t+4; normalization yields the claimed exact constant. Strict coefficient decrease proves P outer; termwise triangle equality forces all complex optimizers to be rotations and phases. Exact-arithmetic checker corroborates elimination and rational root signs.

value.rationale: The coefficient order three and half-exponent are natural and directly motivated by known lower-order exact constants and the recent general outer-polynomial structure. The result is a globally sharp analytic coefficient constant and a complete rigid equality classification, not merely a finite check or reparameterization. The genuine nontrivial interior quartic extremal and exact cubic algebraic value supply a useful benchmark for further coefficient problems.
